code_first.q: Predict the denary value of a hexadecimal pair using positional values.
code_first.code:
firstDigit = 3
secondDigit = 14
value = firstDigit * 16 + secondDigit
print(value)
code_first.a: 3×16+14 = 62; changed to 4 gives 78; both are not above 100.
